item.title: About Us
item.description: Our Story NiaVico began with a question many adult children quietly ask: “Are they really okay?” Our parents value their independence, and we want to respect that. But distance makes reassurance harder. The usual solutions never felt quite right. Daily calls can feel like check-ins. Cameras feel invasive. Medical alert pendants are reactive and often unused. Each option solves one problem while creating another. We’re three longtime software engineers — and fathers — navigating the same generational shift many families face.

item.title: Frequently Asked Questions
item.description: Who is this designed for? NiaVico is designed for families who want a respectful, non-invasive way to stay connected to an aging parent’s wellbeing. It is especially suited for situations where a parent lives independently and family members want reassurance that daily routines are on track — without cameras or constant monitoring. Is this a medical device? No. NiaVico is a wellness monitoring system. It does not provide diagnoses, medical advice, or emergency response services, and it is not a substitute for professional medical care.

item.title: Privacy & Security
item.description: What We Don’t Collect NiaVico does not use cameras or microphones. We do not record video, capture audio, track precise location, or monitor personal conversations. No cameras or video recording No microphones or audio capture No location tracking No conversation monitoring NiaVico does not watch or listen. Ever. What We Do Collect NiaVico uses discreet motion and entry sensors to understand patterns of activity within a home. We collect: Motion and entry signals (for example, movement detected or a door opened) Device connection status Basic system performance data We do not collect detailed behavior logs, personal content, or identifiable in-home events beyond these simple sensor signals.

item.title: Who It's For
item.description: Whether you’re helping a parent live independently, coordinating with siblings, or supporting residents or clients in a professional care setting, NiaVico provides quiet, pattern-based awareness — without cameras or intrusive monitoring. For Families Most families don’t want more surveillance. They want better reassurance. When someone you love lives alone, small questions can grow heavy: Did they wake up at their usual time? Did they move through their normal routine? Was today a normal day?
